content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-6. - Officer designated.
content.summary:
Service of any document or process issued pursuant to this chapter may be made by
               any peace officer of the city; or by any means permitted by state law.
(Code 1960, § 1-23(c); Code 1981, § 18-10)
State Law reference—
Process, C.R.S. § 13-10-111.
